title: 학생군사교육실시령 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9 (Provision of Equipment)
① The Minister of National Defense, in consultation with the Minister of Education, may provide firearms and other equipment necessary for the conduct of military training to the head of the school designated for the officer candidate course, as well as to other personnel involved in military training. (Amended June 22, 2007, March 4, 2008, March 23, 2013, November 29, 2016)
② The management of firearms and other equipment provided in accordance with Article 1 of this Article shall be in accordance with the regulations concerning the management of military supplies. (Amended August 8, 1975)
